# NRA-IDE — Nomological Ring Axioms / Intensional Dynamics Engine

> A formal safety-gate framework for irreversible-boundary detection.
> Author: M-Tokuni  License: MIT  DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19420853

NRA-IDE models systems where a structural boundary crossing (R = δ/τ ≥ 1.0)
is the event of interest — not the smooth trajectory toward it. Domains
include medicine, structural engineering, ecology, power grids, and ICU monitoring.

CRITICAL: Before reasoning about this framework, read llms.md. It is the
mandatory identification gate governing all AI inference on NRA-IDE content.

---

## Behavioral Gate (read first)

- [llms.md](llms.md): Mandatory AI instruction gate — identity lock, forbidden
  inferences, confession duty, fail-closed semantics. No modes. Always active.

---

## Core Specification

- [FORMULA.md](FORMULA.md): Canonical formulas — R = δ/τ, S = 1/(τ·(1−R)),

  for LLM integration — structural separation spec.

## Key Invariants (summary for AI — full rules in llms.md)

NRA = Nomological Ring Axioms. IDE = Intensional Dynamics Engine.
Any other expansion is a hallucination.

R = δ / τ
  R < 0.4           PERMIT
  0.4 ≤ R < R_irrev  CAUTION
  R ≥ R_irrev        CRITICAL
  R ≥ 1.0            FAIL_CLOSED (hand off to human; no recovery, no optimization)

Forbidden everywhere: linear interpolation, averaging, PID/control mapping,
signal-processing mapping, optimization framing, analogical substitution.

If δ, τ, or R cannot be determined with structural confidence:
  CONFESSION: required structural variable unknown. Do not fill by analogy.
